items.q: What did Connect 2026 actually ship, on this report?
items.a: **Muse**, not another metaverse. It lives in glasses, on a Mac, in email, and on a keychain. **Free**, plus a **cut of purchases**. The model is **Muse Spark 1.3**.

items.q: How does Sentinel stop a poisoned login?
items.a: You get a cloud **Linux VM**. **Hatch** runs the loop. Passwords sit in another process. Sentinel hands the agent a **fake token** and swaps the real one. The bounty is up to **$130,000**.
The VM that would hide you from **Meta is still in testing**. By default, what you say and do **can train future models**.

items.q: What are the prices he quotes?
items.a: VR glasses about **100 g**, **5K** micro OLED, next spring, **$1,300**. Ray-Ban Gen 3 **$449**. Audio-only **$349**. **Muse Charm** for the holidays.
